    import adsk.core, adsk.fusion, adsk.cam
    app = adsk.core.Application.get()
    doc = app.activeDocument
    products = doc.products
    design = adsk.fusion.Design.cast(products.itemByProductType('DesignProductType'))
    root = design.rootComponent
    body = root.bRepBodies.item(0)
    print("Face count:", body.faces.count)
    # Classify faces
    planar=[]
    cyl=[]
    for i in range(body.faces.count):
        f = body.faces.item(i)
        geo = f.geometry
        bb = f.boundingBox
        mn=[round(v*10,2) for v in bb.minPoint.asArray()]
        mx=[round(v*10,2) for v in bb.maxPoint.asArray()]
        if isinstance(geo, adsk.core.Plane):
            n = geo.normal

        elif isinstance(geo, adsk.core.Cylinder):
            cyl.append((i, round(geo.radius*10,3), mn, mx))
    print("PLANAR faces:", len(planar))
    for p in planar:
        print("  idx",p[0],"normal",p[1],"min",p[2],"max",p[3],"area",p[4])
    print("CYLINDRICAL faces:", len(cyl))
    for c in cyl:
        print("  idx",c[0],"r",c[1],"min",c[2],"max",c[3])
    return "done"

    sel_type = geometry.get("type", "pocket")

    # Drilling ops carry their geometry on a 'holeModel' parameter whose value is a
    # CadObjectParameterValue — not the 'pockets'/'contours' curve params used by 2D
    # milling. Geometry is committed by assigning .value a PLAIN LIST of the hole's
    # cylindrical faces (an ObjectCollection is rejected by the vector<Base> typemap).
    if sel_type in ("drill", "hole", "holes"):
        p = op.parameters.itemByName("holeModel")
        if p is None:
            raise RuntimeError("operation has no 'holeModel' geometry parameter — "
                               "type='drill' needs a drilling-family strategy")
        cv = adsk.cam.CadObjectParameterValue.cast(p.value)
        cv.value = [body.faces.item(i) for i in geometry["faces"]]
        return
